pensamiento:
I'm going through EV-06 item by item: the title is empty but that's minor, QUS-001 has a clear role, action and benefit so it passes, QUS-002 is atomic with one objective, and QUS-003 has no extra notes. I'm now checking whether the QUS-004 benefit, building experiences across more than one dataset more easily, is really a separate functionality.

I'm checking QUS-005 next: "use metadata" reads more like the user's own way of querying than an imposed technology, so it probably passes. QUS-006 looks like the real defect, since "use metadata to get results" and the vague "more easily" leave the metadata, the results and the combination method undefined, which is a major ambiguity. Then I'm weighing whether QUS-008 duplicates CTX-OS-065 at 0.95 similarity, given the same role and benefit.

Next I'm weighing QUS-008 against CTX-OS-065: it's essentially a duplicate, differing only in "data" versus "metadata," so I'll flag it as a blocker and mention CTX-OS-065. Ahead, I'm checking the other criteria: QUS-009 and INV-001 look fine, INV-002 is clear since the value is explicit for API users, but INV-003 fails because the scope (which metadata, datasets, result format, operations, endpoints) is undefined and can't be estimated. Finally, INV-004 depends on size, so I'll look up a reference story and scale before judging it.

I'm checking DOR-001 next, since the story needs the OpenSpending datasets and the metadata service to exist, and that dependency isn't stated in the text, so it's likely a defect.

I'm checking the DOR items now: the story doesn't name which dataset or metadata service it depends on, which is a defect I'll flag, and there are no limits or error cases for multiple datasets with mismatched metadata, so DOR-002 is a major gap. For DOR-003 I'm unsure whether multiple datasets make this high volume enough to need non-functional requirements, so I'm weighing that before deciding.

I've marked QUS-006, QUS-008, INV-003, INV-005, DOR-001 and DOR-002 as defects. I still need to look up the estimate for INV-004, so I'll check the scale and reference stories now.
